record.dic_text:
02466 cheled {khay'-led}

與 02465 同; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Heled 1; 1

希立 = "短暫的"
1) 尼陀法人巴拿的兒子, 是大衛的大能勇士之一; 也稱作 'Heleb' (SNH02460)
record.edic_text:
02466 cheled {khay'-led}

the same as 02465;; n pr m

AV - Heled 1; 1

Heled = "transient"
1) son of Baanah, the Netophathite, and one of David's mighty
   warriors; also spelled 'Heleb' (02460)
